correctness.rationale: The regular-polygon secondary polytope has affine span the orthogonal complement of constants and the first harmonic in the vertex permutation module. Its dual boundary gives the required geometric noncrossing-diagonal sphere equivariantly. Subgroup vertex orbits yield exact fixed-dimension formulas. Armstrong gives H modulo fixed-point generators: every reflection fixes a point, each proper cyclic generator fixes a point, and full C_n is generated by fixed powers except at powers of two, where only the even powers do. Verified boundary n=6, all quantifiers, and 5508 independent fixed-dimension checks at even n=6..100. The finite checker is corroboration only.

value.rationale: The classification is a mathematically motivated answer to which relabeling subgroups of polygon triangulation spaces leave nontrivial loops. It gives all subgroups for every even polygon size at least six and an exact power-of-two exception, with all geometric fixed-space dimensions as proof-supporting structure. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary finite parameter, even though the proof specializes standard methods and does not determine higher orbit homotopy.
